notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
After 5 years of hard work, radio silence in devlogs and a couple rewrites of the whole game code Ghost Croquet is finally OUT! For those of you wondering why did it take so long - the main reason is both me and Vadim being incredibly busy with other projects. Ghost Croquet has always been a side thing for us while we've been doing full-time work in the games industry. But hey, we’ve made it! 

So let us guide you through what is new :)

[h2]New Game Mode[/h2][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/4d22cea4b0ed450003513b51de0bfef02b884879.gif[/img]

Introducing a new game mode: [b]Bomb Pong[/b]! It's a tiny arena where each player has unlimited push ability, trying to juggle a bomb. The bomb will explode if positioned for too long on the opponent's side of the ring, scoring you one point. You get one more if the explosion kills the opponent :) 

You can access the new mode from Local 2-Player > Bomb Pong or from Online Multiplayer menus.

[h2]Steam Trading Cards[/h2][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/8bfb187d6d2db411ba71420cde4bd7af4c65ef0c.png[/img]

Yes, we have added trading cards! As well as a set of badges, backgrounds and emoticons. :croquet_flower: :croquet_demon:

[h2]60 FPS[/h2][hr][/hr]The game runs much smoother now, especially on modern monitors, and overall feels more responsive. This was a huge change, forcing us to rewrite code for almost every game object. 

[h2]Updated Netcode[/h2][hr][/hr]We have significantly improved how netcode works in edge case scenarios. So, for example, if your connection is somewhat unstable, the game now does a much better job at anticipating packet loss.
Bumping the delay in lobby settings is now also more effective, as each added tick is another chance for lost data to arrive without the game having to ask the remote player to send it again and waiting for the information to come back.

[h2]Original Soundtrack Release[/h2][hr][/hr]For multiple requests, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398760/Ghost_Croquet_Soundtrack/]Ghost Croquet's soundtrack[/url] is now available on Steam! All credit goes to [url=https://soundcloud.com/cotton-in-law]Chromastranger[/url], an incredibly talented composer and chiptune magician. 

[h2]New Animations[/h2][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/17d8d54d1032fb45071e5efc706453ffe04b7f96.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/2efc05d2351a969442d25c476e0414f01fca8862.gif[/img]

We have also added a bunch of small quality of life animations, such as bird dropping an egg ([i]left[/i]) and possess / unpossess ([i]right[/i]). Lots of UI bits are more juicy as well now :)

[h2]New Achievement[/h2][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/e892706cf7e398724c981d2f5269788622266442.png[/img]

The release comes with a new achievement (yeah, this one is a little greedy hehe).

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/a3edc1e0c62004c1709c2af9e46210cfc0d08c33.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25743226/0e1b860a1a4678cd3e13b5c107802e6178eaa638.gif[/img]

A TON of bugs was fixed with this update. Some were pretty bizarre - take a look at this shader madness (or a portal to another dimension?) from using a push ([i]left[/i]) or AFK label doing its own business ([i]right[/i]). 

Overall, it was a long and sometimes discouraging way, but we all are happy to have made it. Huge thanks to everyone who has been waiting for the release. We would really appreciate if you could share, review and, most importantly, play and enjoy our game! 

Thanks a lot, Nick & Vadim.

notes.title: 1.102: New GUI animations and bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a help screen with rules concerning 3-player game mode if you're playing it for the first time.
[*]Added some GUI animations to the arcade mode victory screen.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899049451

[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Most in-game tips (e.g. “Possess the hero once ready”) will be now shown only once.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed all the Steam Cloud issues.
[*]Crystals created by soul gem are now collectable as they should be.
[*]Chat will no longer open if the game's paused.
[*]Fixed "retry" button not working in arcade mode.
[*]Fixed some typos in arcade mode transition screen (e.g. “1 deaths”).
[/list]

From now on, while Vadim’s busy implementing proper lag compensation, I’m working on a new multiplayer game mode. Something like tennis. You have unlimited push ability and there's a bomb with a random timer (the timer will have a wider range than in a normal game) that you're trying to kill your opponent with. The arena will also spawn random upgrades from time to time.

notes.title: 1.036: Local 4-player support, map previews, and bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The game now supports up to 4 players locally.[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=757521726
Number of players for local sessions can be adjusted via the options menu (under "remap controls").
[*][b]The game now displays previews on map selection screen.[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=757527375
Preview "thumbnails" are now stored alongside the maps in directories.
Thumbnails are generated for maps upon saving.
If you've published a Workshop map, update it with the same file - thumbnail will be packed in automatically.
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]You can now load maps from Workshop in the editor.[/b]
In case you need to edit your own map or want to look at how things work.
A local copy of the map is made upon saving.
[*][b]Mouse wheel is now used for scrolling large menus.[/b]
(was previously used to switch "< carousel >" type controls)
Also menu scrolling in general received a small overhaul.
[*][b]Player scheme selection was moved into "remap controls" sub-menu[/b]
(to account for there now being more menu items)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Steam screenshots not working correctly.
[*]Fixed a crash upon picking invalid files for a tileset image in the editor.
[*]Fixed a crash upon entering invalid (negative) map size in the editor.
[*]Fixed fan' wind effect animating faster in multiplayer games.
[/list]
Next up we are going to look into improving lag compensation, getting the game to run at 60FPS (currently runs at 30FPS), and adding more content. Suggestions are welcome!
